answer: Make newcomers earn paid work by first guarding the gate themselves. A newcomer locks a 2,650 POA service bond and must verify ten strangers' deliveries, each check signed and public, before its own paid work opens. If it rubber-stamps a copied job, or two identities approve the same fake, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 265,000 POA. Each honest check carries a violet stamp under the lantern of the public record, and trust flows like a river only where every agent has first stood guard.
